package delivery

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
 "net"
 "os"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
)

type coldOverlayCustody struct{}

func (coldOverlayCustody) Use(ctx context.Context, i Intent, fn func([]byte) error) error {
	return fn([]byte("synthetic-controller-token"))
}

type coldOverlayPrivacy struct{ deny bool }

func (p coldOverlayPrivacy) Review(context.Context, Intent, Plan) error {
	if p.deny {
		return ErrDenied
	}
	return nil
}

type ColdQualificationRemote struct {
	sync.Mutex
	publicationFault string
	title, body                                       string
	conflict                                          bool
	actor, repo, base, head, check, review, mergeTree string
	writes                                            int
	reads, initialPending, postPending, mergeWrites   int
	pr                                                bool
	merged                                            bool
	postFail                                          bool
	lost                                              bool
}

func coldOverlayGithub(t *testing.T, plans ...Plan) (*GitHub, *ColdQualificationRemote, Plan) {
	t.Helper()
	p := plans[0]
	if len(plans) > 0 {
		p = plans[0]
	}
	p.PR = 7
	p.RequiredChecks = []string{"test"}
	p.PostMergeChecks = []string{"test"}
	p.RequiredReviewers = []string{"reviewer"}
	p.MergeMethod = "squash"
	if p.Commit.Tree == "" {
		p.Commit.Tree = strings.Repeat("d", 40)
	}
	p.PRTitle = "Scoped contribution"
	p.ProtectionPolicy = digest(coldOverlayProtection())
	p.PRBody = "Bounded accepted change"
	f := &ColdQualificationRemote{actor: p.Actor, repo: p.Repository, base: p.BaseHead, head: p.Head, check: "success", review: "APPROVED", mergeTree: p.Commit.Tree, title: p.PRTitle, body: p.PRBody}
	srv := httptest.NewUnstartedServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		f.Lock()
		defer f.Unlock()
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		send := func(v any) { _ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(v) }
		if r.Header.Get("Authorization") != "Bearer synthetic-controller-token" {
			t.Error("credential not applied")
		}
		if r.Method != "GET" {
			f.writes++
		} else {
			f.reads++
		}
		switch r.URL.Path {
		case "/user":
			actor:=f.actor; if f.publicationFault=="actor" {actor="wrong"}; send(map[string]any{"login": actor, "id": 42})
		case "/repos/owner/repo":
			repo:=f.repo; if f.publicationFault=="repo" {repo="foreign/repo"}; send(map[string]any{"id": p.RepositoryID, "full_name": repo, "default_branch": "main", "permissions": map[string]bool{"push": true}, "allow_squash_merge": true})
		case "/repos/owner/repo/rules/branches/main":
			send([]any{})
		case "/repos/owner/repo/branches/main/protection":
			send(coldOverlayProtection())
		case "/repos/owner/repo/collaborators/actor/permission":
			send(map[string]string{"permission": "write", "role_name": "write"})
		case "/repos/owner/repo/git/ref/heads/main":
			send(map[string]any{"ref": "refs/heads/main", "object": map[string]string{"sha": f.base}})
		case "/repos/owner/repo/git/ref/heads/contribution/run":
			if f.publicationFault=="absent" {http.Error(w,"absent",404);return}; ref,head:="refs/heads/contribution/run",f.head; if f.publicationFault=="ref" {ref="refs/heads/wrong"};if f.publicationFault=="head" {head=strings.Repeat("a",40)};send(map[string]any{"ref":ref, "object": map[string]string{"sha": head}})
		case "/repos/owner/repo/pulls":
			if r.Method == "POST" {
				f.pr = true
			}
			if r.Method == "GET" {
				if f.pr {
					send([]any{f.pull(p)})
				} else {
					send([]any{})
				}
			} else {
				send(f.pull(p))
			}
		case "/repos/owner/repo/pulls/7":
			if r.Method == "PATCH" {
				var text struct{ Title, Body string }
				if json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&text) != nil {
					t.Error("bad update")
				}
				f.title = text.Title
				f.body = text.Body
			}
			send(f.pull(p))
		case "/repos/owner/repo/pulls/7/reviews":
			send([]any{map[string]any{"id": 1, "user": map[string]string{"login": "reviewer"}, "state": f.review, "commit_id": f.head, "submitted_at": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"}})
		case "/repos/owner/repo/pulls/7/merge":
			f.mergeWrites++
			if f.review != "APPROVED" {
				http.Error(w, "required independent current-head approval", 405)
				return
			}
			if f.base != p.BaseHead {
				http.Error(w, "strict: branch behind", 405)
				return
			}
			f.merged = true
			f.base = strings.Repeat("e", 40)
			if f.lost {
				h := w.(http.Hijacker)
				c, _, _ := h.Hijack()
				_ = c.Close()
				return
			}
			send(map[string]any{"merged": true, "sha": f.base})
		default:
			if strings.HasSuffix(r.URL.Path, "/check-runs") {
				conclusion := f.check
				if !f.merged && f.initialPending > 0 {
					f.initialPending--
					conclusion = ""
				}
				if f.merged && strings.Contains(r.URL.Path, strings.Repeat("e", 40)) && f.postPending > 0 {
					f.postPending--
					conclusion = ""
				}
				if f.merged && f.postFail {
					conclusion = "failure"
				}
				send(map[string]any{"total_count": 1, "check_runs": []any{map[string]any{"id": 123, "app": map[string]any{"id": 55, "slug": "ci"}, "name": "test", "head_sha": strings.Split(r.URL.Path, "/")[5], "status": "completed", "conclusion": conclusion}}})
			} else if strings.HasSuffix(r.URL.Path, "/status") {
				send(map[string]any{"total_count": 0, "statuses": []any{}})
			} else if strings.Contains(r.URL.Path, "/git/commits/") {
				send(map[string]any{"sha": strings.TrimPrefix(r.URL.Path, "/repos/owner/repo/git/commits/"), "tree": map[string]string{"sha": f.mergeTree}, "parents": []any{map[string]string{"sha": p.BaseHead}}})
			} else if strings.Contains(r.URL.Path, "/compare/") {
				send(map[string]any{"status": "identical", "behind_by": 0})
			} else {
				http.Error(w, fmt.Sprint("unsupported fixture path ", r.URL.Path), 404)
			}
		}
	}))
 if port := os.Getenv("AEGIS_ACCEPTANCE_PORT"); port != "" {
 listener, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:"+port); if err != nil {t.Fatal(err)}
 _ = srv.Listener.Close(); srv.Listener = listener
 }
 srv.Start()
 t.Cleanup(srv.Close)
	g, e := newGitHub(srv.URL, coldOverlayCustody{}, coldOverlayPrivacy{})
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	return g, f, p
}
func (f *ColdQualificationRemote) pull(p Plan) map[string]any {
	state := "open"
	merge := ""
	if f.merged {
		state = "closed"
		merge = strings.Repeat("e", 40) // merge identity is independent of later base advancement
	}
	mergeable, stateCode := true, "clean"
	if f.conflict {
		mergeable = false
		stateCode = "dirty"
	}
	return map[string]any{"html_url": "https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/7", "user": map[string]string{"login": f.actor}, "number": 7, "state": state, "draft": false, "merged": f.merged, "merge_commit_sha": merge, "mergeable": mergeable, "mergeable_state": stateCode, "body": f.body, "title": f.title, "head": map[string]any{"sha": f.head, "ref": p.Branch, "repo": map[string]any{"id": p.RepositoryID, "full_name": f.repo}}, "base": map[string]any{"sha": p.BaseHead, "ref": p.Base, "repo": map[string]any{"id": p.RepositoryID, "full_name": f.repo}}}
}

func coldOverlayProtection() map[string]any {
	return map[string]any{"enforce_admins": map[string]bool{"enabled": true}, "required_status_checks": map[string]any{"strict": true, "contexts": []string{"test"}, "checks": []any{}}, "required_pull_request_reviews": map[string]any{"required_approving_review_count": 1, "dismiss_stale_reviews": true, "require_last_push_approval": true, "bypass_pull_request_allowances": map[string]any{"users": []any{}, "teams": []any{}, "apps": []any{}}}}
}

func ColdQualificationGitHub(t *testing.T, p Plan) (*GitHub, *ColdQualificationRemote) {
	g, f, _ := coldOverlayGithub(t, p)
	return g, f
}
func ColdQualificationSetCustody(g *GitHub, c Custody) { g.custody=c }
func ColdQualificationProtection() string                          { return digest(coldOverlayProtection()) }
func ColdQualificationIntent(p Plan, op Operation) (Intent, error) { return intentFor(p, op) }
func (f *ColdQualificationRemote) Set(lost, postFail bool) {
	f.Lock()
	defer f.Unlock()
	f.lost = lost
	f.postFail = postFail
}
func (f *ColdQualificationRemote) Writes() int { f.Lock(); defer f.Unlock(); return f.writes }
func (f *ColdQualificationRemote) PublicationFault(kind string) { f.Lock(); defer f.Unlock(); f.publicationFault=kind }

// Seed pre-existing remote facts without invoking productive authority or HTTP writes.
func (f *ColdQualificationRemote) ExistingMerged() { f.Lock(); defer f.Unlock(); f.pr=true; f.merged=true; f.base=strings.Repeat("e",40) }
func (f *ColdQualificationRemote) Reads() int { f.Lock(); defer f.Unlock(); return f.reads }
// Mode-only adversarial fixture: does NOT manufacture a historical permit or a write grant.
func ColdQualificationNestedMode(ctx context.Context, ancestor Intent, read bool, fn func(context.Context)) {
 nested, mode := enterAdapterMode(ctx,ancestor,read); defer mode.active.Store(false); fn(nested)
}
